mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserInterestCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TB_USINTR WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
mapper.sql: CLUB.CLUB_NUMB , CLUB.OWNR_NUMB , OWNER.USER_NICK AS OWNR_NICK , CLUB.CLUB_NAME , CLUB.CLUB_CNTN , CLUB.CLUB_VISB , CLUB.JOIN_TYPE , CLUB.CLUB_STAT , CLUB.MAXX_MEMB , CLUB.REGI_DATE , COALESCE(SEAT.MEMBER_CNT, 0) AS MEMBER_CNT , COALESCE(SEAT.INVITED_CNT, 0) AS INVITED_CNT

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB , SUM(CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MEMBER_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberInvited} AND MEMBER.EXPR_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INVITED_CNT FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER GROUP BY MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB ) SEAT ON SEAT.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB

SELECT /* getMyClubList */
, MINE.MEMB_STAT , MINE.MEMB_ROLE FROM TB_CLMEMX MINE JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = MINE.CLUB_NUMB AND CLUB.CLUB_STAT = #{clubActive} LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM OWNER ON OWNER.USER_NUMB = CLUB.OWNR_NUMB
WHERE MINE.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND MINE.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} ORDER BY MINE.JOIN_DATE DESC , CLUB.CLUB_NUMB DESC

SELECT /* getFindClubList */
, MINE.MEMB_STAT , MINE.MEMB_ROLE , PENDING.JOIN_STAT , COALESCE(MATCHED.MATCH_CNT, 0) AS MATCH_CNT FROM TM_CLUBXM CLUB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM OWNER ON OWNER.USER_NUMB = CLUB.OWNR_NUMB
LEFT JOIN TB_CLMEMX MINE ON MINE.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB AND MINE.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB , APPLICATION.USER_NUMB , MAX(APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT) AS JOIN_STAT FROM TB_CLJOIN APPLICATION WHERE APPLICATION.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending} GROUP BY APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB , APPLICATION.USER_NUMB ) PENDING ON PENDING.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB AND PENDING.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CATEGORY.CLUB_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS MATCH_CNT FROM TB_CLCATE CATEGORY JOIN TB_USINTR INTEREST ON INTEREST.INTR_CODE = CATEGORY.INTR_CODE AND INTEREST.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY CATEGORY.CLUB_NUMB ) MATCHED ON MATCHED.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB WHERE CLUB.CLUB_VISB = #{clubPublic} AND CLUB.CLUB_STAT = #{clubActive}
AND ( CLUB.CLUB_NAME LIKE #{keywordLike} OR CLUB.CLUB_CNTN LIKE #{keywordLike} )
ORDER BY COALESCE(MATCHED.MATCH_CNT, 0) DESC , CLUB.REGI_DATE DESC , CLUB.CLUB_NUMB DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT /* getClubForUpdate */ CLUB_NUMB , OWNR_NUMB , CLUB_NAME , CLUB_CNTN , CLUB_VISB , JOIN_TYPE , CLUB_STAT , MAXX_MEMB , REGI_DATE FROM TM_CLUBXM WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getClubCategoryList */ CATEGORY.INTR_CODE , DETAIL.COMD_NAME AS INTR_NAME , PARENT.COMD_NAME AS INTR_CNAM , CATEGORY.SORT_ORDR FROM TB_CLCATE CATEGORY JOIN TB_CODEXD DETAIL ON DETAIL.COMM_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND DETAIL.COMD_CODE = CATEGORY.INTR_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD PARENT ON PARENT.COMM_CODE = DETAIL.COMM_CODE AND PARENT.COMD_CODE = DETAIL.UPPR_CODE WHERE CATEGORY.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} ORDER BY CATEGORY.SORT_ORDR
SELECT /* getClubQuestion */ CLUB_NUMB , QUES_FIRS , QUES_SECO , QUES_THIR , QUES_FOUR , QUES_FIFT FROM TB_CLQUES WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb}
SELECT /* getClubMember */ CLUB_NUMB , USER_NUMB , MEMB_ROLE , MEMB_STAT , EXPR_DATE , BLOC_YSNO FROM TB_CLMEMX WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getClubMemberList */ MEMBER.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , '/img/common/icon-user.svg' AS PORF_PATH , MEMBER.MEMB_ROLE FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} ORDER BY CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_ROLE = #{ownerRole} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , MEMBER.JOIN_DATE , MEMBER.USER_NUMB

SELECT /* getMutualFollowCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TB_FOLLOW OWNERFLOW JOIN TB_FOLLOW USERFLOW ON USERFLOW.USER_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB AND USERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} WHERE OWNERFLOW.USER_NUMB = #{ownerNumb} AND OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getInviteCandidateList */ USERX.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , USERX.INTR_CNTN , FILEX.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH FROM TB_FOLLOW OWNERFLOW JOIN TB_FOLLOW USERFLOW ON USERFLOW.USER_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB AND USERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM FILEX ON FILEX.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB WHERE OWNERFLOW.USER_NUMB = #{ownerNumb} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = USERX.USER_NUMB ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLJOIN APPLICATION WHERE APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND APPLICATION.USER_NUMB = USERX.USER_NUMB AND APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending} ) ORDER BY USERX.USER_NICK , USERX.USER_NUMB

SELECT /* getInvitationList */ MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB , CLUB.CLUB_NAME , SENDER.USER_NICK AS SENDER_NICK , MEMBER.INVT_DATE , MEMBER.EXPR_DATE FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB AND CLUB.CLUB_STAT = #{clubActive} LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM SENDER ON SENDER.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.SEND_NUMB WHERE MEMBER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberInvited} AND MEMBER.EXPR_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY MEMBER.INVT_DATE DESC

SELECT /* getPendingApplication */ CLUB_NUMB , APPL_NUMB , USER_NUMB , QUES_FIRS , QUES_SECO , QUES_THIR , QUES_FOUR , QUES_FIFT , ANSR_FIRS , ANSR_SECO , ANSR_THIR , ANSR_FOUR , ANSR_FIFT , JOIN_STAT , APPL_DATE FROM TB_CLJOIN WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending}

SELECT /* getApplicationList */ APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB , APPLICATION.APPL_NUMB , APPLICATION.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , FILEX.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , APPLICATION.QUES_FIRS , APPLICATION.QUES_SECO , APPLICATION.QUES_THIR , APPLICATION.QUES_FOUR , APPLICATION.QUES_FIFT , APPLICATION.ANSR_FIRS , APPLICATION.ANSR_SECO , APPLICATION.ANSR_THIR , APPLICATION.ANSR_FOUR , APPLICATION.ANSR_FIFT , APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT , APPLICATION.APPL_DATE FROM TB_CLJOIN APPLICATION JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = APPLICATION.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM FILEX ON FILEX.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB WHERE APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending} ORDER BY APPLICATION.APPL_DATE , APPLICATION.APPL_NUMB

SELECT /* getApplicationForUpdate */ CLUB_NUMB , APPL_NUMB , USER_NUMB , JOIN_STAT , APPL_DATE FROM TB_CLJOIN WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND APPL_NUMB = #{applNumb} AND JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending} FOR UPDATE
